transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble focusing lately. My mind just won't really stay on one thing anymore. Like, at work... I'm a jeweler, so I'm at the bench a lot... I'll jump from reading a customer email to looking at a saw mark, or I'll hear a noise outside and... I don't know. Next thing I know, I realize I’ve lost the whole work order. It's just... getting hard to keep my thoughts straight, I guess.
When did you first start having this trouble with your focus?

Um... I guess it started a little while ago. Right after this jewelry show... I got an award. After that, things just got kind of... wired. It was just this out-of-control stretch that went on for about two weeks, I think.
During that two-week wired stretch, did you need less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess so. For a while there, I was only sleeping maybe... two or three hours. But I wasn't tired. I'd wake up completely clear-headed and... I don't know, just excited to get to work. I'd end up cutting stones or putting up new designs before sunrise.
During that two-week period, did you feel unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual mood?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I just felt... I don't know, really lit up after the show. Like I was larger than life or something. But... I guess I got kind of short with people, too. If anyone told me to slow down, or... asked me to stick to normal shop hours... I'd just snap at them. I just didn't want to be interrupted, I guess.
During that wired period, did your behavior cause major problems in your work or relationships?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I kind of... missed a big custom delivery. The shop records just got really disorganized, so... I had to stop taking new work for now. And, um... my family's been checking in on me a lot more. I guess they got worried about... how far I'd slipped from my usual routine.
Before this recent wired period, have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Um... yeah. Actually, these past couple weeks have been... kind of like that. I just... wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. Like the shine has just gone out of everything. I've... I've even cried in the truck a few times before opening up the shop. So... yeah.
Did the heavy, hollow depression and crying happen at the same time as the period when you felt wired and needed very little sleep?
Um... no, not really. The... the wired feeling was first. And then... I don't know, it just sort of stopped. And then this heavy feeling started. They didn't really happen at the same time.
During that wired period, did you hear or see things that other people could not, or strongly believe things that others said were not true?
Um... no. No, nothing like that. I didn't see anything or... or believe anything weird. I was just... working a lot. That's all.
During that wired period, did you start or increase any drugs, medications, or other substances?
Um... no. I didn't take anything. Just... coffee, I guess. But no drugs or anything like that.
During these past couple of weeks, have you had thoughts of killing yourself or ending your life?

Um... yeah. A little bit, I guess. I just... I keep thinking that maybe my family, and... and the people I make pieces for... maybe they'd just be better off if I wasn't here anymore. I don't... I don't know how I'd do it or anything. I don't have a plan. But... it kind of scares me how much I've been thinking about it lately.
